text:
Jack Roslovic is the one Leaf having a good month. He has 14 points in his last 10 games, points in eight of nine per CBS Sports, and since Kirill Marchenko went down he's moved onto the first power-play unit and up to 18:36 a night.

Our numbers call it earned. Toronto creates more with him on the ice than it usually does, and the Leafs take 53% of the expected goals at five on five with him out there, ten points better than without him, on a team that's been losing the chance battle. By our win probability his goals have added more wins than all but 17 skaters in the league.

Some of it will cool. He's shooting 17% and his points per 60 are well above our range for him. But on his sixth NHL team, a year after 36 points in Edmonton, he's found a role he can keep. Our range: 53 to 76 points.
